author: Sparrow30
quote: Too much forced romance and toxic relationship drama. Unequal cheating rules, no breakup option, poor parenting and terrible robbers. Less freedom, weaker humour, clunky shooting, restrictions and repetitive chores. Bugs, microtransactions and paywalled content hurt the experience. Standard players risk missing content locked behind Ultimate editions. Only liked the FF car and GTA 4 nod.
